Name: Official - Industrialization for CFR
Author: DraLUSAD
Description:
Looking for a PFM version, go here [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5102]Industrialization for PFM[/url]

[b]Machines available:[/b]

[u]Electric Furnace: [/u]
Smelts ores twice as fast, and can smelt Pulverised dust, does not need coal to operate

[u]Alternator E. Furnace: [/u]
Comes with an automate feature in mind, which does not accept ores, but instead takes only crushed metals, goes well with "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url]" (You will also need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/991?tab=files&file_id=23124]CFAutomate[/url]﻿ as well to function properly)

[u]Pulveriser: [/u]
Breaks down 5 ores for 2 pulverised dusts, it can then be smelted (just 1) at either electric furnace(s) for its respected bar, can also smelt Quartz and Fire Quartz too

[u]Electric Mining Driller:[/u]
A very powerful drill which can extract 25 units of resources every 12 hours, requires 1 battery to operate

[u]Combustion Generator: [/u]
Converts 5 coal into 1 battery pack
Converts 1 Solar Essence into 3 battery pack

[u]Solar Generator: [/u]
A powerful generator which takes a full days worth of sunlight to produce 1 battery packs, does not work whiles indoors, or when its raining
[b]Credits to a user "Mouse" [/b](Discord) [b]for helping me add code![/b]

[u]Gem Polisher:[/u]
An exotic machine which cleans and shines Gems, bringing out the best quality

[u]Rock Smasher:[/u]
Can smash stone for a chance of ore, but it can fail and give gravel instead, can also process all geodes for Minerals and artefacts

[u]Hay Bin:
[/u]Converts 10 fibre into 10 Hay, daily

[u]Garden Cloche:
[/u]An extremely powerful machine, able to grow any 25 seeds into iridium quality crop, Time may vary depending on seed type, can be used in any season


[b][b]Next [/b]Update![/b] V2.0.0-RC2

New Machines:
Tree Cloche - nurse trees for a lot of wood
Hay Redehydrator - Does the opposite of the Hay Bin
Mineral Washer - allows mineral based stones to reach max quality
More QoL Improvements and balances
and More!
